cases.structure: palace-tree; central grain storage at Hattusa, redistribution outward, elite-only literacy, single capital
evidence_needed: storage capacity distribution: central vs household

cases.structure: palace-tree; Linear B is administrative-only, no non-palace literate layer

cases.shock: Late Bronze Age collapse + prior central failures
cases.structure: second attractor present. Annual Nile flood = distributed input to every household. Subsistence did not route through palace even where accounting did. Fragmented to nomes, kept functioning, recoalesced.
evidence_needed: provincial elite tomb investment during IP vs unified periods

cases.structure: loopy extreme. Tyre/Sidon/Byblos/Arwad as parallel nodes, no single capital. Alphabetic script cheap enough to escape scribal monopoly. Merchant-held rather than palace-held capital. Lose Sidon, function migrates to Tyre.
evidence_needed: alphabet diffusion rate vs cuneiform/Linear B
capital ownership: private vs palace, from contract evidence
node substitution: trade volume shift on individual city loss

cases.structure: SQUEEZE case, not poverty case. Customary tenure (heritable use right, FIXED obligation) is a different position than tenancy-at-will with obligation revisable by one party. Same word 'serf' covers both. Scarcity should have moved terms toward the tenant; wage caps and movement restriction held terms against the scarcity signal.
cases.measurable: is the obligation fixed or unilaterally renegotiable; who holds the residual on a good year
evidence_needed: manorial court rolls: tenure type by decade
Statute of Labourers enforcement density vs revolt geography

cases.shock: consumer-role reassignment, two-earner necessity, priced access
cases.structure: middle band as uncommitted labor time attached to local knowledge, not as a wealth bracket. Free-entry shared space (lodges, YMCA, women's clubs, farmers markets, granary, feed store) = the parallel paths. Conversion mechanism: access became priced (building has to make rent) -> loop becomes trunk WITHOUT any decision to dismantle. State/NGO substitute is a trunk: single path, externally funded, revocable.
measurable: count of local functions with exactly ONE provider
free-entry vs priced-entry shared square footage per capita
evidence_needed: see sources.json group PROCEDURAL and group INSTRUMENT

cases.shock: electronic control, sealed units, proprietary diagnostics, part pairing
cases.structure: DISTINCT failure class. Foxfire-type procedures still execute if read. Repair knowledge can be INTACT and still not execute, because the object stopped accepting it. Repairability was in the machine, not only in the person. Cash for a used vehicle from someone local = fully self-custodied position, same shape as C09.
cases.measurable: fraction of failure modes serviceable with hand tools + published manual, by model year

cases.structure: self-custodied (no counterparty), inflation-indifferent, DIVISIBLE under emergency (sell three pieces not the set), carries transmission with it (object arrives with knowledge of its function). Period writing treats it as a mechanism of transferring savings, not as bragging.
cases.failure_mode: OBJECT PERSISTS, FUNCTION RECLASSIFIED. Later reader files the same objects as heirlooms and loses the function. Same overwrite as C07 lodge shells and the nostalgia case.

cases.structure: Christmas clubs, passbook accounts, war-bond payroll deduction, building-and-loan share plans. MECHANISM IS THE INSTRUMENT, NOT THE VIRTUE: deliberately illiquid, small fixed increment, EXTERNAL RATCHET. Long horizon is the default rather than something sustained by will. Credit inverts: converts horizon into a present object, moves the ratchet to the other side.
cases.note: horizon is readable off the INSTRUMENT, not off anyone's account of their outlook. Passbooks have entries.

cases.structure: distrust is a CORRECT READING of current instruments, not a mindset defect. Someone refusing a 20-year commitment has evidence. Old instruments were locally held and locally visible: a building-and-loan lent to people in the same town. Trust was VERIFIABLE AT WALKING DISTANCE, not extended on faith.
cases.still_working: credit unions, rotating savings clubs (ROSCAs) — work for exactly this reason, require no belief in anything uncheckable
cases.links: same discriminator as C05: function verifiable locally vs routed through a node you cannot see
